text.description_html:
Brass Accents A02-K5131-US15, Satin Nickel Colonial Door Knocker With Eye Viewer

This Colonial Door Knocker With Eye Viewer has a traditional style that goes nicely with historical homes. It is 6 inches high--just the right size for most doors. The peephole adds extra security.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Their products are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the world's leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

Also available: Surface Mount Colonial Door Knocker.

Specifications Colonial Viewer Door Knocker with Peep Hole:

  • Height: 6"
  • Mounting Centers: 3-15/16" (distance between the 2 mounting screws)
  • Max Thickness: 3/4"
  • Eye Viewer: 1/2" Diameter
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
